## A figure

```{r}
#| label: fig-example
#| fig-cap: "A test figure, drawn with the format's figure defaults."

library(ggplot2)
mtcars |>
  ggplot(aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Scatter plot of MPG vs Weight",
    x = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
    y = "Miles per Gallon"
  )
```
